title: Derivatives of the Hermite generating exponential
statement: For every integer $k\ge 0$ and all complex numbers $x,z$, the $k$th complex derivative at $z$ of $w\mapsto\exp(xw-w^2/2)$ equals $H_k(x-z)\exp(xz-z^2/2)$, where $H_k$ is the Hermite polynomial.
